provenance.label: max G in (t,t+2h] >=180 while G(t)<180, OR max G-G(t)>=70; synthetic mg/dL
provenance.evaluation: 60/20/20 grouped original IDs; bootstrap identities never cross splits; scalers and medians train only
provenance.threshold: Max F2 on validation only. Fixed 0.30 also reported.
provenance.weekly_target: Any modeled spike decision window after burn-in OR rule-defined weekly cardiovascular anomaly
provenance.mrt: Treatment-centered regression with risk interaction, prior-day peak and day covariates; trajectory-cluster robust SE; imposed effects, not clinical treatment evidence
provenance.simulation: Original AR mean-reversion, circadian HR and OU-style SBP/HRV kernels retained; not clinically calibrated
limitations: Independent re-simulation and bootstrap variation do not measure external clinical validity
